read_by: 0x3C 0x3D (every slot 0..N), the search (reference status for raw ids and type 4; candidate status for types 2, 3, 5..11)
meaning_in_the_binary: entity state, 1 Loaded, 2 Normal, 3 Deactivated, 4 FlagToDestroy, 0 free; the tests are `(status - 1) <u 3`
montage_rule: one proxy per slot 0..N; status 0 = a proxy still in the list with Status Destroyed (the binary slot is read, so the proxy exists); values above 4 are not in the vectors
stop_rule: any other status value in a vector is a stop

meaning_in_the_binary: pointer to the parent entity or 0
montage_rule: null = 0; slot k = slot[k].LogicContextEntity; 'foreign' = a new Entity that is no slot's LogicContextEntity
stop_rule: a pointer that is neither 0, a slot address nor 'foreign' is a stop

meaning_in_the_binary: PlatformEntity: non-null only for a carried object
montage_rule: null / non-null (a slot's LogicContextEntity or a foreign Entity)

read_by: search raw-id branch (bit 0x80 clear), compared with the whole word
meaning_in_the_binary: EntityRefId, the record index; the hero's is -1
montage_rule: hero: -1; others: the record index; compared as int == the operand byte (0..127)
stop_rule: a hero whose EntityRefId is not -1 is a stop of the montage (a bare proxy defaults to 0 and would match raw id 0)

read_by: 0x60 (each candidate), 0x61 (the logic entity), search types 5 and 6
meaning_in_the_binary: RidingEntity: the entity this one rests on, set by the physics pass of the previous tick
montage_rule: null = 0; slot k = slot[k].LogicContextEntity; 'foreign' = a new Entity; the test NEVER calls EntitySupport.UpdateRidingEntities

read_by: NEVER READ by the four handlers (read by 0x3F, not by 0x60/0x61)
montage_rule: vectors with "blocked": true set it non-null in the binary memory AND in the montage; the binary result does not change: that is the proof it is not read
stop_rule: a read of it is a stop

meaning_in_the_binary: index of the last used slot (inclusive)
dll_member_in_the_montage: SpawnedEntities (slots 0..N); the hero is also PlayerEntity
montage_rule: vector.n = N; slots n+1..9 hold attractive junk in the binary memory and are absent from the montage
stop_rule: a read of a slot above N is a stop (none occurs)

dll_member_in_the_montage: EventProgramState.Codes[CodeIndex + k] through EventProgramRunner.FillDataFromCommand: v[k], int 0..255
stop_rule: any other code byte read is a stop

read_by: all four (0x3C, 0x3D ignore it: they scan the table); 0x60/0x61 use it as carrier/rider and as the reference of the search
meaning_in_the_binary: the logic entity of the program
dll_member_in_the_montage: the `entity` parameter of EventProgramRunner.Dispatch = owner.LogicEntity ?? owner

meaning_in_the_binary: the entity whose program runs (the hero for a map event)
montage_rule: free in the tests (the vectors fix it to the hero in the binary run)

read_by: all four write it, on every path
montage_rule: the expected value of the vector
stop_rule: any other write outside Result and the results buffer is a stop (none occurs)
